Well, I guess I should not have mentioned [[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 54|Aielmen]].<br />
[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 2|These Tairens]] don't like their fear.<br />

Bain [[Maiden's Kiss|kissed]] at the point of a spear.<br />

Escape failed to include in [[Finn#Mat Cauthon 2|three Finnish requests]].<br />

Fools, they get lucky, and I guess I must be one too.
